name: Matthew Knauss
tagline: Top rated DUI-DWI attorney in Kirkland, Washington
about: As an attorney at Knauss Law Firm in Kirkland, Washington, Matthew Knauss focuses his practice on criminal defense and related matters. His practice encompasses a range of offenses, including domestic violence, driving under the influence, theft, reckless driving and assault. He assists individuals confronting criminal allegations and provides legal counsel throughout the various stages of their cases.

Mr. Knauss takes a thoughtful and strategic approach to criminal defense, considering the circumstances and legal issues involved in each matter. He works closely with those he represents to evaluate their options, address the challenges presented by the allegations and pursue an appropriate course of action. His experience includes handling cases that can carry significant legal, financial and personal consequences for individuals and their families.

Throughout his career, Mr. Knauss has focused on helping clients address criminal charges through informed legal representation. His practice covers both misdemeanor and more serious criminal matters, as well as allegations involving impaired driving, domestic disputes, property offenses, reckless conduct and assault. He seeks to ensure that clients understand the legal process and the considerations that may affect the outcome of their cases.

Mr. Knauss earned his Bachelor of Science degree from the University of Denver in 2001. He subsequently attended Seattle University School of Law, where he received his Juris Doctor degree in 2004. That same year, he was admitted to practice law in Washington and has continued serving clients in the state throughout his legal career.

In addition to his work on behalf of clients, Mr. Knauss remains involved with professional organizations dedicated to the practice of criminal defense. He is a member of the Washington Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the National College for DUI Defense.
